title: London In A Day Guided Tour
short: The ultimate London sweep — 30+ world-famous sights in a single unforgettable day with an expert live guide, starting at the iconic Great Scotland Yard Hotel.
desc:
From the majestic Buckingham Palace to the historic Tower of London, experience the city's most iconic landmarks in comfort and style. Beginning at the world-famous Great Scotland Yard Hotel, you'll wander through Westminster, admire St. Paul's Cathedral, and soak in the charm of Covent Garden.

Stand in the shadow of a thousand years of history overlooking the Tower of London and Tower Bridge, with expert commentary from your personal guide bringing London's rich history to life. Ride the iconic vintage Routemaster bus (if in service) and uncover hidden gems, secret streets, and the authentic character of local London.
highlights: Buckingham Palace to Tower of London
Ride on iconic vintage Routemaster bus
Great Scotland Yard Hotel start point

title: Big Sights London Taxi Tour
short: Your own private Black Cab, your own expert guide. Over 20 landmarks including Buckingham Palace and the Changing of the Guard.
desc:
Enjoy unparalleled views of London from the privacy and comfort of your own iconic London taxi. Your expert driver-guide will introduce you to over 20 of the most famous landmarks including Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace, St. Paul's Cathedral, the Tower of London, and much more.

Pick up and drop off at any central London location. The Changing the Guard ceremony is included subject to schedule.
highlights: Pick up & drop off anywhere central

title: Royal London with Changing the Guard
short: Front-row seats for one of the world's great ceremonies. Bearskins, bugles, three working Royal Palaces — plus a pub lunch on Whitehall.
desc:
Experience the pageantry of Royal London with an expert local host who brings history to life. Watch the precision timing and ceremonial splendour as eighteen-foot bearskins, gleaming plumes, and spirited military marches unfold outside Buckingham Palace, then follow the guard through the grand avenues of St James's and the Horse Guards Parade.

Enjoy a front-row glimpse of royal tradition that's quintessentially London, then settle into a specially selected Whitehall pub for a proper lunch.
highlights: Front row Changing of the Guard

title: Westminster Highlights Tour
short: The corridors of British power in one immersive stroll. Parliament, Downing Street, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben — and the stories behind them all.
desc:
Embark on a Westminster Highlights Tour led by an Expert Local Guide and discover London's heartbeat in a single immersive stroll. From Trafalgar Square through the stately precincts of three working royal residences — St James's Palace, Clarence House, and Buckingham Palace — to the imposing Palace of Westminster, seat of Parliament and power.

Stand before Horse Guards Parade in ceremonial dress, stroll through tranquil St James's Park, and follow the corridors of power along Whitehall and Downing Street. Visit Westminster Abbey, where kings are crowned and legends laid to rest, then gaze upon Big Ben and Parliament Square.

title: Westminster Highlights with Afternoon Tea
short: All the grandeur of Westminster, crowned with a traditional British Afternoon Tea at the legendary Great Scotland Yard Hotel.
desc: The full Westminster Highlights experience — all the iconic landmarks, all the royal drama — with an unmissable ending: traditional British Afternoon Tea at the Great Scotland Yard Hotel, the former HQ of London's Metropolitan Police, now a luxurious hotel steeped in intrigue, elegance, and centuries of British history.

title: Beatles Black Taxi Tour
short: Follow the Fab Four across London in a private Black Cab. Abbey Road, Apple Corps, the homes and studios — the whole legendary story.
desc:
Prepare to follow in the footsteps of The Fab Four in your own private Black London Taxi. Your expert driver-guide will show you where The Beatles lived, recorded, and performed, as well as some of the most important places in their private lives.

Stop at the famous Abbey Road crossing, visit the former Apple Corps building where The Beatles played their legendary last rooftop gig, and hear the stories behind every address.
highlights: Apple Corps — site of the last gig
Pick up & drop off anywhere central

title: Rock & Roll Legends of London Tour
short: A backstage pass to London's rock history. The Beatles, Bowie, The Stones — the studios, streets, and clubs where modern music was born.
desc:
Turn up the volume and discover the wild side of the capital on our Rock and Roll London Tour. From legendary recording studios to the streets where music history was made, we explore the places that shaped the sound of modern music.

Stand where icons like The Beatles, David Bowie, and The Rolling Stones recorded, played, and sometimes caused a little trouble along the way.

title: Ted Lasso Film Location Tour
short: Be curious, not judgmental. Walk Richmond as AFC Richmond — visit the actual pubs, streets, and filming spots from everyone's favourite show.
desc:
Follow in the footsteps of everyone's favourite coach on our Ted Lasso Tour of London. Visit the charming streets and cosy pubs of Richmond — the neighbourhood that doubles as the home of AFC Richmond — and see the famous spots where characters shared big laughs, lessons, and plenty of biscuits with the boss.

You'll discover behind-the-scenes stories from the show, recognise iconic filming locations, and soak up the friendly village atmosphere that makes Richmond feel like a character in its own right.
highlights: The Crown & Anchor — the Ted Lasso pub
Perfect for fans of any age

title: USA Founding Fathers in London Tour
short: On America's 250th anniversary — trace the road to independence through London's streets. Where Franklin argued, Adams plotted, and a nation was born.
desc:
On the 250th anniversary of the United States, step back into the story of America's beginnings on our Founding Fathers Tour of London, where the road to independence started long before the American Revolution.

Wander through the very streets where colonial agents, philosophers, and future revolutionaries once lived, argued, and plotted their ideas for a new nation. Uncover surprising London connections to figures such as Benjamin Franklin and John Adams, who spent crucial years here representing the American colonies.
highlights: Historic taverns of the colonial era

title: Historic London Pub Crawl
short: 4 of London's oldest and most characterful pubs. Dickens drank here. Johnson too. Learn the slang, nail the etiquette, earn your local status.
desc:
Experience London the way locals have for centuries on our Historic Pub Crawl. Wander through atmospheric lanes and hidden alleys as we visit some of the city's most characterful and historic pubs, each with its own stories, legends, and colourful past.

You'll hear tales of writers, rebels, and rogues who once raised a glass here — figures like Charles Dickens and Samuel Johnson. Pull up a chair, grab a pint, and toast your way through London's incredible pub culture.
highlights: The real boozers, not tourist traps

title: Bus Tour of London with Live Guide
short: The classic London experience — open top, live English commentary, iconic double-decker. Maximum sights, non-stop route, unobstructed views.
desc:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through London aboard our open-top, double-decker bus — the quintessential way to see the capital's iconic landmarks. From Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament to the shimmering Thames bridges and historic streets of Westminster, every turn offers panoramic, photo-ready moments.

With a non-stop route designed to maximise sightseeing, you'll glide past world-famous sights while enjoying fresh air and unobstructed views with live English commentary throughout.

title: London by Night Bus Tour
short: London positively glitters by night. See every landmark transformed under the lights — 6 evening departures with a live English-speaking guide.
desc:
London positively glitters and glistens by night! For a different take on London's most famous landmarks, how better to see them than after dark? The London by Night Bus Tour has been perfectly curated to present a magical take on a magical city.

Each of the 6 departures is hosted by a live English-speaking guide, there to bring the city to life with information and entertainment. Your guaranteed seat upstairs means unobstructed views of London's illuminated skyline.
